SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_payment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN spending_category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS classified_payment_count
FROM financial_transaction_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND created_at >= #{startAt} AND created_at < #{endAt}

SELECT transaction_id AS transactionId, merchant_name AS merchantName, amount, created_at AS createdAt
FROM financial_transaction_tbl
WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND spending_category_id IS NULL AND created_at >= #{startAt} AND created_at < #{endAt}
ORDER BY created_at DESC, transaction_id DESC

SELECT spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, category_name AS categoryName, parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId FROM spending_category_tbl ORDER BY CASE WHEN parent_category_id IS NULL THEN spending_category_id ELSE parent_category_id END, parent_category_id IS NOT NULL, spending_category_id
SELECT spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, category_name AS categoryName, parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId FROM spending_category_tbl WHERE spending_category_id = #{spendingCategoryId}

-- COALESCE: 앞이 null이면, 뒤에것 실행 SELECT COALESCE( parent_category.spending_category_id, category.spending_category_id ) AS spendingCategoryId, -- 하위 카테고리를 선택하기 위한 용도
COALESCE( parent_category.category_name, category.category_name ) AS categoryName, -- 하위 카테고리를 선택하기 위한 용도
SUM(ft.amount) AS spendingAmount, -- 카테고리 별 최종 금액 합계 COUNT(*) AS transactionCount -- 총 거래 건수
FROM financial_transaction_tbl ft
INNER JOIN spending_category_tbl category ON ft.spending_category_id = category.spending_category_id
LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl parent_category ON category.parent_category_id = parent_category.spending_category_id
WHERE ft.user_id = #{userId} AND ft.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND ft.transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND ft.spending_category_id IS NOT NULL AND ft.created_at >= #{startAt} AND ft.created_at < #{endAt}
GROUP BY COALESCE( parent_category.spending_category_id, category.spending_category_id ), COALESCE( parent_category.category_name, category.category_name )
ORDER BY spendingAmount DESC, transactionCount DESC, spendingCategoryId ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spending_analysis_tbl ( user_id, analysis_period, -- AI분석기간 representative_category_id, -- 가장 소비비중이 큰 카테고리 ai_title, -- AI가 설정한 별명 ai_analysis_summary -- AI의 소비분석 결과 요약 ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{analysisPeriod}, #{representativeCategoryId}, #{aiTitle}, #{aiAnalysisSummary} )

INSERT INTO spending_analysis_category_tbl ( spending_analysis_id, spending_category_id, -- 어떤 소비 카테고리의 결과인지 확인 spending_amount, -- 해당 카테고리에서 사용한 총 금액 spending_ratio, -- 전체 중 해당 카테고리가 차지하는 비율 transaction_count -- 해당 카테고리 결제 건수 ) VALUES -- 한번에 다중 insert할 수 있는 구문이다.
( #{category.spendingAnalysisId}, #{category.spendingCategoryId}, #{category.spendingAmount}, #{category.spendingRatio}, #{category.transactionCount} )
